title: FREE CAR WASH!
subtitle: First-time customers get a complimentary wash
redeem_steps: Complete and submit the form below using your mobile phone number.
After submitting the form, you will receive a text message at the phone number you provided. The text will contain a link to your free wash QR code.
Please allow up to one hour (or longer during busy periods) to receive your text message and QR code.
Your free wash cannot be redeemed without the QR code. Be sure to wait until you receive it before visiting the wash.
Once you have received your QR code, simply bring it to Uptown Car Wash and present it to our team to redeem your free #3 Express Wash.
important_notes: A valid QR code is required for redemption.
The QR code will be sent to the mobile phone number entered on the form.
Processing times may vary, so please allow adequate time before your visit.
